run_interactive_chat: run an interactive chat session with a trained ParlAI model using keyboard input
setup_interactive_args: set up command-line arguments for interactive chat including display options and output file settings
create_interactive_world: create a task world with a human agent and model agent for interactive dialogue
log_conversation: log interactive conversation turns to a JSONL or ParlAI format output file
register_interactive_script: register the interactive script with the ParlAI CLI under the interactive or i alias
